body.p: You can preview images and SVG files in a separate pane. The supported image types are GIF, JPEG/JPG, PNG, and BMP.

There are several ways to open an image in the Image Preview pane:
In the Project view, double-click the image name.
In the Project view, right-click the image and select Preview.
In the DITA Maps Manager view, double-click the key definition of the image.
In the DITA Maps Manager view, right-click the key definition of the image and select Open.
In Text mode, use Ctrl + Mouse Click or Ctrl + Enter while the cursor is inside the image file path. After the image is displayed in the Image Preview pane, you can access some contextual menu actions by right-clicking anywhere in the pane:
Open in System Application - Opens the image in the default image editor for your platform.
1:1 - Scales the image to its original size.
Scale to fit - Scales the image down to fit in the pane.
Fit to width - Downscales or upscales the image so that its full width fits within the pane. This is useful, for example, when moving the preview on top of an open editor to transcribe the screenshot of a manuscript page.
Print preview... - Previews how the image would be printed.
Print... - Prints the image to the configured printer.
If the image is an SVG file, the Image Preview pane also includes the following contextual menu actions: Zoom in, Zoom out, Rotate, and Refresh.

While the Image Preview view is visible, selecting an image in the Project view or DITA Reusable Components view automatically displays the resource in the view. Also, as long as the Link with Editor toggle action (located on the Project view toolbar) is enabled, focusing on the image in the Image Preview view selects the image file in the Project view.
body.note: You can drag an image from the Image Preview view and drop it into a DITA, DocBook, or TEI document.
